tail_light_detail.description: Sleek black sports car red tail light

layout_strategy.nav_bar: Fixed bottom tab navigation with glassmorphism (bg-[#0B0B0D]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#2A2D35]).
layout_strategy.header: Sticky top header with minimal height, bg-[#0B0B0D]/90 backdrop-blur-md, z-50.
layout_strategy.live_auction_screen: Full viewport height. Top 60% is a cinematic car image with linear gradient overlay (to top, #0B0B0D, transparent). Bottom 40% is the interactive bid module overlapping the image.
layout_strategy.cards: Vertical stack for feed, horizontal scroll for 'Featured' or 'Quick Filters'.
layout_strategy.forms: Floating labels or clear labels outside inputs. High contrast active states.

data_testid_conventions.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, based on role.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic tailwind grays (slate/gray); use the defined hex codes (e.g. #0B0B0D, #16181D) to maintain the graphite/metallic feel.
Ensure the deep metallic red (#B91C1C) is used sparingly for primary CTAs, Live badges, and winning states only. Overuse will kill the luxury vibe.

Use standard semantic HTML mapped to Expo React Native Web components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, Image) since this is a mobile web app / PWA context if using React DOM, or directly React Native elements. Ensure you stick to the framework context requested by the user.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast. Silver/chrome (#E2E8F0) should be used for primary text instead of pure white to maintain the automotive feel.
Images MUST be pulled from the 'media' object provided in this JSON. Do not use placeholders.
For the live auction screen, implement a pulsing animation on the current highest bid to simulate real-time action.
